set_seed: set the random seed for reproducible behavior across random, numpy, and torch
compute_snr: compute the signal-to-noise ratio for given timesteps using a noise scheduler
compute_confidence_aware_loss: compute a confidence-aware training loss combining supervised cross-entropy and entropy penalty
free_memory: free GPU memory by running garbage collection and clearing the accelerator cache
EMAModel: create an exponential moving average model to track shadow parameters during training
